items.details: If Woozie rejects the mission for insufficient underwater ability, train by diving and surfacing before the breath meter empties, then return when he accepts your improved stat. Do not rely on contradictory percentage thresholds from old guides. The mission is available at night, from 20:00 to 06:00. During the approach, use underwater movement to avoid patrols, surface in safe gaps and watch the breath meter. Keep enough health for the shipboard section instead of exhausting yourself before boarding.

items.details: Take the prepared car into the factory and follow the marked interior path before arming it. Remove nearby defenders so they cannot trap you beside the blast. Once the device is active, leave promptly rather than continuing to fight inside. Keep enough room to approach the ramp straight; abandoning the escape after the explosion does not complete the mission.
